UPDATE expert_consultations 
SET status = 'completed', 
    completed_at = NOW(),
    duration_seconds = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - started_at)),
    output_analysis = '{{ $('Update Shared Context').first().json.markdownReport }}',
    output_artifacts = '{{ JSON.stringify($('Update Shared Context').first().json.analysis) }}'
WHERE project_id = '{{ $json.projectId }}' 
  AND expert_name = 'infrastructure-reviewer'
  AND iteration_number = 1;
